title: Resort_Gorgeous
lead_summary: Resort Gorgeous is a location north of the Water Labyrinth in the Sevii Islands. This location originally appeared in Pokémon Fire Red and Leaf Green. Selphy, a wealthy Pokémon Trainer, permanently resides in the resort. She asks the player to show her a fusion between two Pokémon. The fusion she wants to see is random and it changes every in-game day. If the player shows her the fusion she requested, she will give the player a reward.
